name: Hermes Skills Hub
summary: The skills system in Nous Research's Hermes Agent, where the agent writes, patches and deletes its own SKILL.md skills as procedural memory, alongside a hub for installing skills from other sources. A background Curator grades, merges and prunes the library on a schedule. Hub installs pass a built-in security scanner.
facts: official, skills.sh, well-known URLs, GitHub, ClawHub, LobeHub
Background grading and pruning, 7-day default (since v0.12.0)
goodFor: Agents that learn reusable workflows over time
Pulling skills from several registries in one CLI
Reviewing agent-written skills before they land
watchOut: Agent-written skills can drift; use the approval gate
Tied to the Hermes Agent runtime
Fast release cadence with breaking renames
